item.title: Wall Street posts its best week since April 2025 as a December Fed rate hike looks near certain.

item.title: Oil nears $97 after reported mine hits on two tankers and a strike on a Saudi refinery.
item.description:
Brent crude rose to $97.31 a barrel on Friday after Iran's IRGC said two tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi Arabia said a strike suspended some operations at its Jazan refinery on November 26. OPEC+ meets Sunday.
A Nepali worker was killed at Jazan, Arab News reports. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com

item.title: The US proposes new tariffs of 15% to 35% on China, the EU, India and 11 other economies.
item.description:
The US Trade Representative proposed new Section 301 tariffs on 14 economies on November 25, with top rates of 35% for Vietnam, 25% for India, 20% for China and 15% for the EU and Japan. Comments are due January 5 and hearings start January 25.
China's commerce ministry said it firmly opposes the plan. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com
